content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Centralized platforms like Stripe and PayPal offer convenience at the cost of sovereignty. They handle payment processing, fraud prevention, and compliance—until they don’t. When they restrict your country, your business stops. Decentralized alternatives like NOWPayments and Coinbase Commerce offer crypto payment processing but require you to build your own infrastructure for product delivery, order storage, and customer communication. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack combines the best of both worlds: automatic crypto payment verification via NOWPayments, instant product delivery via Cloudflare R2, and order storage in Supabase. It’s deployed on your GitHub or Cloudflare account, so you own the entire stack. No platform lock-in. No subscriptions. Full data ownership. This isn’t a plugin or a theme—it’s base-layer infrastructure designed for creators in restricted regions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal use a compliance-first model. If your country’s financial system triggers their risk algorithms, they block access without recourse. This isn’t about your individual business—it’s about their exposure to regulatory penalties. Decentralized crypto processors like NOWPayments don’t care about your location because they operate on blockchain networks. However, they don’t provide hosting, storage, or delivery solutions. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack bridges this gap by integrating NOWPayments with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and R2. You get the benefits of decentralized payments without the complexity of building your own backend. The stack is deployed in your cloud account, so it’s immune to platform restrictions. If Cloudflare or Supabase ever restrict your region, you can migrate the stack to another provider because you own the code and data.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal process payments instantly but charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. They also hold funds for days or weeks, especially for high-risk accounts. Crypto processors like NOWPayments charge 0.5% per transaction and settle payments on-chain within minutes. However, you’re responsible for wallet management and network fees. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack integrates NOWPayments with recommended low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON, keeping transaction costs under $0.10. The stack’s one-time fee of $197 covers deployment, configuration, and 30-day support. After that, your only ongoing costs are network fees and optional Supabase storage charges. This model eliminates platform fees and fund holds, giving you full control over your cash flow.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you ownership, not just access.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Stripe and PayPal, you rent access to their infrastructure. They own your customer data, transaction history, and payment processing logic. Decentralized tools give you ownership but require manual setup and maintenance. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack automates the entire process: payment verification, order storage, and product delivery. Once deployed, the stack runs without your intervention. Customers pay in crypto, the webhook triggers file delivery from Cloudflare R2, and the order is logged in Supabase—all in real time. You own the GitHub or Cloudflare account where the stack is deployed, so you control every component. No platform can shut you down or change the rules mid-game.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a region Stripe supports and prefer convenience over sovereignty, centralized platforms might work—for now. If you’re in a restricted region and comfortable with crypto, decentralized tools offer a viable alternative but require technical expertise. If you want a permanent, platform-independent solution that combines the benefits of both models, COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack is your best option. It’s built for creators who value ownership, automation, and resilience. The stack isn’t a workaround—it’s a structural shift. You’re not renting infrastructure; you’re deploying it. Not depending on platforms; you’re building on protocols. The choice is clear: continue seeking permission from platforms that exclude you, or deploy your own sovereign commerce stack.

It integrates automatic crypto payment processing via NOWPayments, instant product delivery via Cloudflare R2, and order storage in Supabase. Deployed in your cloud account, the stack gives you full ownership and control. Unlike centralized platforms that restrict access based on location, the Edge Commerce Stack is immune to regional blocks. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more and take the first step toward infrastructure ownership.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your deployment platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and provide global CDN distribution. 2. Set up a NOWPayments account to enable crypto payment processing. Select low-fee networks like BSC or Solana. 3. Configure Supabase for order storage. Create a table to log transactions and customer details. 4. Upload your digital products to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for instant delivery. 5. Deploy the Edge Commerce Stack to your chosen platform. COREMERCH handles the integration of NOWPayments, Supabase, and R2. 6. Test the stack end-to-end: simulate a purchase, verify payment confirmation, and ensure file delivery. 7. Load your products into the system. The Edge Commerce Stack supports up to 5 products out of the box. 8. Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email deliverability if you plan to send receipts or updates. 9. Launch your store and start selling. You own the infrastructure—no platform can shut you down.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Edge Commerce Stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The stack is deployed and configured by COREMERCH. You get a fully operational store without writing code. After deployment, basic maintenance requires no technical skills.
What happens if Cloudflare or Supabase restricts my region?
Since the stack is deployed in your cloud account, you own the code and data. You can migrate to another provider or self-host the components. Your business remains operational.
Do my customers need a crypto wallet to purchase?
Yes, but they don’t need an account with NOWPayments. They can pay using any wallet or exchange that supports the selected cryptocurrency. The process is straightforward.
How are transaction fees calculated?
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. Network fees depend on the blockchain used—BSC, Solana, and TRON keep costs under $0.10. You pay no additional platform fees.
What support is included with the Edge Commerce Stack?
The $197 fee includes deployment, configuration, and 30-day email support. After that, you own the stack and can manage it independently or purchase additional support.
Deploy once, own forever—no subscriptions, no platform lock-in.
